text: Stein began by measuring: letter counts along the text and the index of coincidence at every number of strands. Here the same for K4, seventy-one measurements fixed before the run.
Each measurement against a thousand shufflings of K4's own 97 letters; only a value no shuffling reaches counts as a feature.
Nothing lies outside every shuffle. The doublets lining up in sevens and the repeats 21 apart are the least ordinary, as before (p 0.002 and 0.004). No new item.
